hint.AUTO: Inside when it fits, otherwise outside with a leader line. Best default.
hint.OUTSIDE: Always beside the element: never covers the design, but needs free room around it.
hint.INSIDE: Always within the measured area: compact, but can overlap small elements.

hint.DESIGN: Sizes are fixed in design pixels: consistent across the board, but small at low zoom and large at high zoom.
hint.VIEWPORT: Sizes are adjusted to the current zoom when drawn: readable now, but they look off at other zoom levels.
